interfaces.transport: HTTPS browser and POST /api/ask on the generated public application origin

response.citations: At most two source-owned IDs/titles/revisions/HTTPS URLs and exact supporting quotes
response.abstained: Boolean; unknown or unsupported evidence yields a canonical abstention

interfaces.identity: Explicit anonymous public-only reader; same-origin browser requests are not authentication. No private source or article-edit HTTP endpoint.
interfaces.permissions: Dedicated workload identity reads the private public-content catalog. Separate existing company editor identity receives native conditional catalog write authority. Destination role scopes are emitted in Terraform.
interfaces.sourceLifecycle: Read current version before retrieval and recheck before returning. Exact version/digest mismatch withholds the answer; missing/inaccessible source never serves cached or empty fallback. Operator CLI edits require observed version plus confirmation and native compare-and-swap.
interfaces.limits: 100 genuinely public UTF-8 articles up to 30000 bytes each; at most two complete relevant articles, no silent truncation. Questions up to 2000 UTF-8 bytes, five admitted calls per instance and excess calls receive 429.

errors.503: Unverified policy, source changed/unavailable, or invalid/unavailable model answer

interfaces.retries: No automatic browser/model retry; conditional editor conflict requires reload/review. Clear cancels local presentation and rejects late responses.
interfaces.quality: Exact JSON, source membership and supporting quotes are checked; these do not prove factual entailment. Real answer/citation/abstention, freshness, IAM, model latency and budget/abuse testing remain required.

interfaces.transport: Local operator CLI to fixed native HTTPS object-store API; no app editing endpoint
interfaces.identity: Existing authorized company editor role/group supplied as reviewed destination input; generated role grants stay separate from workload read access
interfaces.request: Inspect current catalog version; explicitly confirm public-only init or conditional upsert/delete. Full UTF-8 articles, source-owned IDs/revisions and optional HTTPS links. No secrets in bundle or chat.
interfaces.response: Native ETag/generation after successful conditional write; concurrent edit yields conflict and requires reload/review. No automatic overwrite retry.
interfaces.permissions: AWS separate assumed role Get/Put on catalog.json; Azure container-scoped Blob Data Contributor; Google bucket-scoped object get/create/delete custom role; IBM bucket-scoped Object Reader/Object Writer existing access group. Inherited permissions require separate destination review.
interfaces.acceptance: Local native-transport fixtures test conditions, source updates/deletions and unauthorized/failed writes. Effective IAM and real storage APIs remain unverified.

evidenceBoundary: Compiler-defined contracts; actual service behavior, model quality and account access require independent tests.
